icons.label: Tap dance shoe
icons.use_for: Tap dancing, tap instruction and dedicated tap performances.
icons.avoid_for: Other dance styles, ordinary shoes or percussion without tap dance.

icons.label: Singing bowl
icons.use_for: Singing-bowl performances and practice; representative category artwork for Sound Bath tags.
icons.avoid_for: Food bowls; automatic assignment to every sound bath event, gong-only programs or general meditation.

icons.label: Animation
icons.use_for: Animation and anime topic tags, animation screenings and animation-making activities.
icons.avoid_for: All Japanese culture, manga-only programs, live-action film, or music events merely inspired by animation.

icons.label: Hand puppetry
icons.use_for: Hand/glove puppet performance or making; representative artwork for umbrella Puppetry and Puppet Show tags.
icons.avoid_for: Automatically illustrating marionette, shadow-puppet or other explicitly different mechanisms with a hand puppet.

icons.label: Risograph printing
icons.use_for: Risograph printing and workshops, explicitly using a stencil duplicator.
icons.avoid_for: Generic home printing, laser printing, screen printing or a specific RISO model claim.

icons.label: Vibraphone
icons.use_for: Explicit vibraphone performance, lessons, featured players or instrument tags.
icons.avoid_for: Marimba/xylophone, generic percussion, or all jazz.

icons.label: Chamber ensemble
icons.use_for: Chamber Music and Chamber Ensemble topic tags and dedicated chamber programs without a suitable specific lineup icon.
icons.avoid_for: Inferring exact player count from the three symbolic stands; a large orchestra or all classical music.

icons.label: Musical duo
icons.use_for: Two-person musical duos, including acoustic and jazz duo topic tags.
icons.avoid_for: Comedy duos, partner dancing, soloists, or assuming a specific instrument lineup.

icons.label: Oud
icons.use_for: Explicit oud lessons, featured oud performance and instrument-specific topics.
icons.avoid_for: Generic Arabic, Levantine or Middle Eastern music, culture, perfume/agarwood, or another lute.

icons.label: Printmaking
icons.use_for: Printmaking and block-printing topic tags; relief printing with a brayer and pulled impression.
icons.avoid_for: Automatically depicting etching, lithography or other explicitly different printing methods with a brayer scene; generic painting.

icons.label: Performance stage
icons.use_for: Performance Space and Performing Arts topic tags; a neutral stage category emblem.
icons.avoid_for: Specific venue architecture, a claim that every performance uses a proscenium, or automatic place reassignment from hosted events.

icons.label: Historic site
icons.use_for: Historic Site topic tags; generic heritage designation plaque.
icons.avoid_for: A claim about a particular site’s architecture, official protected status, nation or culture; automatic place assignments.

icons.label: Partner dance
icons.use_for: Partner Dance, Social Dance and explicit paired dance styles such as ballroom dance, salsa, bachata, swing and Lindy Hop.
icons.avoid_for: Music-only tango/salsa concerts, solo dance, venue Ballrooms as rooms, or a fixed gender pairing requirement.

icons.label: Contemporary dance
icons.use_for: Contemporary Dance and Modern Dance topics and performances.
icons.avoid_for: Yoga, generic Classical Dance across traditions, ballet-specific pointe work or a named traditional costume.
